meta.title: Pencil-Derived Tailwind + CSS Vars Token System (Auth Form + Products)

goal: Define a Tailwind + CSS variables token system derived from Pencil for the Auth form and Products screens, including a new Effects group (gradients, shadows, strokes), with aliasing rules to reuse existing values.
users: Frontend engineers implementing Auth and Products screens
constraints: Spec-only: do not implement code or modify files.
Tokens must be derived from Pencil for Auth form + Products screens.
Complex form gradients and outlines in Auth form must be represented as Effects tokens.
Allow aliases when a value already exists to avoid duplication.
Follow existing UI-kit token naming scheme where applicable (CSS vars under :root).

in: Token extraction from Pencil for Auth form + Products
Tailwind token mapping strategy (theme.extend + CSS vars)
Effects token group: gradients, shadows, strokes
out: Updating docs, generated files, or UI behavior

assumptions: Pencil source of truth exists for Auth form + Products UI.
Current UI-kit tokens are authoritative for existing usage.
Tailwind configuration consumes CSS vars instead of hardcoded values.
unknowns: Exact Pencil token values for Auth form and Products (colors, gradients, shadows, strokes).
Whether Pencil exposes token names or only raw values.
Any existing Tailwind config conventions in this repo beyond UI-kit tokens.

requirements.text: Derive a complete token list from Pencil for Auth form + Products, including colors, spacing, radii, typography, and effects.
requirements.rationale: Ensures fidelity to design source of truth.

requirements.text: Introduce an Effects token group with gradients, shadows, and strokes as first-class tokens.
requirements.rationale: Auth form uses complex gradients and outlines that must be tokenized.

requirements.text: Provide an aliasing rule: if a Pencil value matches an existing token, reference the existing token instead of duplicating.
Define Tailwind mapping for all tokens using CSS variables (theme.extend or equivalent).
requirements.rationale: Keeps runtime theming and CSS var parity.

requirements.text: Produce a diff vs current UI-kit tokens, listing additions, modifications, and deprecations.

acceptance_criteria: Token spec lists all tokens required for Auth form + Products screens (including effects).
Effects tokens explicitly capture complex Auth form gradients and outlines.
Alias rules are documented with at least one example for colors and effects.
Diff vs current UI-kit tokens is included and categorized (add/modify/deprecate).
A compact, implementation-ready task list for coder is included.

effects.description: Effects are top-level groups: shadow, gradient, stroke. Effects tokens should be stored in a new tokens file.

tailwind_mapping.strategy: Tailwind theme extends values pointing to CSS variables.

aliasing_rules: If a Pencil color value matches an existing UI-kit color token, define the new token as an alias to the existing token.
If a Pencil gradient/shadow/stroke matches an existing effect token, alias instead of duplicating.
Document alias relationships in tokens.docs.json with 'aliasOf' metadata (if supported) or description text.

add: New Effects token group (gradients, shadows, strokes).
Auth form complex gradients and outlines as effects tokens.
Products screen-specific effects tokens (if present in Pencil).
Any missing semantic colors, spacing, radii, or typography required by Pencil.
modify: Tailwind mapping to include effects tokens and any new Pencil-derived tokens.
tokens.docs.json to document effects tokens and aliasing.
deprecate: Any new raw-value tokens that duplicate existing tokens must be replaced by aliases (no net-new values).
diff_vs_current.notes: Exact token names and values are to be extracted from Pencil. The above diff categories describe expected changes relative to current UI-kit tokens listed in this PRD.

deliverables: Token list derived from Pencil for Auth form + Products (values + names)
Diff report vs current UI-kit tokens (add/modify/deprecate)

tasks.summary: Extract Pencil tokens for Auth form + Products
steps: Enumerate all colors, spacing, radii, typography, and effects used in Auth form and Products.
Tag tokens with intended semantic role and proposed token name.
tasks.acceptance: Complete token list with values and semantic names sourced from Pencil.

steps: Identify all gradients, shadows, and strokes in Auth form + Products.
Create effect token names and values, ensuring complex Auth gradients/outlines are captured.
tasks.acceptance: Effects tokens cover all gradients/shadows/strokes, including Auth form outlines.

steps: Compare Pencil values to existing UI-kit tokens.
Mark exact matches as aliases (no new values).
tasks.acceptance: All matching values are aliased; no duplicate raw values introduced.

steps: Map all tokens to Tailwind theme extension keys (colors, shadow, backgroundImage, borderColor, etc.).
tasks.acceptance: Every token has a Tailwind mapping referencing CSS vars.

tasks.summary: Diff report vs current UI-kit tokens
steps: Classify each Pencil-derived token as add/modify/deprecate/alias relative to current tokens.
Summarize deltas in a compact list for review.
tasks.acceptance: Diff report is complete and categorized.

risks: Pencil may not encode gradients/strokes in a token-friendly structure, increasing manual interpretation.
Token aliasing could hide subtle differences if values are close but not identical.
Tailwind mapping for complex gradients may require custom utilities.
dependencies: Access to Pencil source files for Auth form + Products.
Agreement on token naming conventions for new Effects group.
Confirmation of Tailwind configuration location and format.
open_questions: Where is the Pencil file for Auth form + Products located in the repo or accessible externally?
